book.name: Yoan
book.title: Vaaru poia tau Yoan iboode Jon—John

content: Yes zaaba tilos Yesu ve tipamogheraini imin i kinik
Tauvene Piladus isaav pa zaaba tooni gha tigham Yesu ve tilosi.
Ve tigham waar tuatua gha titalia, ve tighuru izala Yesu daaba imin moghar ndamoonda to yes kinik. Ve tisik nonoghiiŋa ŋgereeta imin dagilgil
izala paavo. Ra tamtamon toozi eŋaeŋa tilaagh tila tiyooz ila naagho, ve tisaav pani tighe: “Aa, kinik to yes Yuda, mboŋoozo poia! Yei nipakur ghom!” ve tipoposaii.
Piladus isaav ighe tirav Yesu imaat
Tighamgham tauvene, ve Piladus ivot ila muuri, ve isaav pa eval tiina ighe: “Aghita. Yau aat nagham ŋeer tawe ivot ilam payam. Leso awatagh aghe yau naghita naghe i le sosor eta mako.”
Tauvene Piladus igham Yesu ivot ila muuri. Waar tuatua igheen ila daaba, ve nonoghiiŋa ŋgereeta imin dagilgil igheen ila tiini. Ra Piladus isaav pa eval tiina ighe: “Aghita! Tamtamon tauta ene!”

Yes daaba to watooŋrau tomania uraata siriv to Rumei Tiina tighita Yesu, ve tiboob tighe: “Uravu izala ai pambarooŋ! Uravu izala ai pambarooŋ!” Eemon Piladus isaav pazi ighe: “Yam taumim aghamu ala, ve aravu izala ai pambarooŋ. Pa yau naghita naghe i le sosor eta mako.”
Yes Yuda tiyol aliiŋa tighe: “Yei lemai tutuuŋ. Ve tutuuŋ tsiei isaav ighe: Tamtamon tauvene, i aat imaat. Pasaa, ipakur tauu ighe i Maaron Naatu.”
Piladus ilooŋ saveeŋ toozi tane le roiŋ tiina ighamu.
Tauvene iloŋ ila ruum loolo muul, ve ighason Yesu ighe: “Yo saa ŋeer? Ulaagh mindai ta ulam?” Eemon Yesu iyol aliiŋa mako. Ineneeŋ mon.

Tauvene Piladus ighasoni muul ighe: “Puughu mindai ta uyol aliŋag mako? Yo ukankaan payau? Aazne, yo uleep ila yau nimag. Yau leg tapirig to napul ghom ula, ve leg tapirig to nasaav, ve tirav ghom izala ai pambarooŋ.”

Yesu iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Isaav ighe Maaron to sambam ipul ghau ila nimam mako, ene aat yo lem tapirim to ugham gabua eta payau mako. Tauvene ŋeer tau ighur ghau ila nimam na, sosor tooni iliiv sosor tsio.”

Piladus ilooŋ saveeŋ tane, ra iil eez to ipul Yesu ila. Eemon yes Yuda tiboob ila pani tighe: “Isaav ighe yo upul ŋeer tana ila, na yo kinik tiina to Rom eeta mako. Pasaa, tamtamon tisov tau tipakur tauzi tighe yes kinik, ene tizoor kinik tiina to Rom pooz tooni.”

Piladus ilooŋ saveeŋ tane, ve igham Yesu gha yesuru tivot tila muuri, ra Piladus mboole ila niia to gharatooŋ saveeŋ. Niia tawe igheen nugh tau tiwaat eeza ila saveeŋ Hibru tighe ‘Gabata’ (‘Gabata’ puughu tauvene: nugh tau tiraar maet babaŋazi ila imin nugh to lepoogh.)
Saawe tana, ene saawe to gharatooŋ aniiŋ ma gabua pa Pasova. Ve aaz izalam zegmatuugh wa. Piladus isaav pa yes Yuda ighe: “Aghita. Kinik tsiam tane!”

Eemon tiboob ila pani tighe: “Mako. Ŋeer tana ileep sov! Ughamu ila, ve uravu imaat. Uravu izala ai pambarooŋ!” Tauvene Piladus ighason zi muul ighe: “Lolomim mindai, aghe yau narav kinik tsiam tane izala ai pambarooŋ?” Yes daaba to watooŋrau tiyol aliiŋa tighe: “Yei lemai kinik ite paam mako. Kinik tiina to Rom, i mon ta kinik tsiei.”
Tauvene Piladus ilooŋ aliŋazi, ve ipul Yesu ila zaaba tooni nimazi. Leso tiravu izala ai pambarooŋ.
Tirav Yesu izala ai pambarooŋ

Tauvene tigham Yesu ila, ve tauu ibaad ai pambarooŋ tooni. Tipul nugh tiina Yerusalem gha tivot tila muuri, ra tinau pa nugh mbua ee, eeza ‘Daaba rubruuba.’ Tiwaat nugh tawe eeza ila saveeŋ Hibru tighe ‘Golgata.’
Tila tivot ta sewe, ra tirav Yesu toman zeran ru paam ila ai pambarooŋ. Ra tipayooz ai pambarooŋ to Yesu ila bodbodaaŋ, ve zeran ru tawe, ee ila pa ŋas, ve ite ila pa tapir.
Ve titaghon saveeŋ to Piladus, ve tibood mateegh tooni puughu ila ndiu sirivu ee, ra tiravu izala ai pambarooŋ tooni daaba. Paesiiŋ tawe isaav ighe: “Yesu to Nasaret, kinik to yes Yuda.”
Saveeŋ tane, tiboode ila saveeŋ Hibru, Roma aliŋazi, ve yes Grika aliŋazi paam.
Nugh tau tirav Yesu izala ai pambarooŋ pani na, ene igheen igharau Yerusalem. Tauvene yes Yuda eval tilam tighita saveeŋ tana, ve tiwaato.
Tauta yes daaba to watooŋrau tila to Piladus, ve tisaav pani tighe: “Yo ubood ughe ‘kinik to yes Yuda’ sov. Yo aat ubood saveeŋ tauvene: ‘Ŋeer tane isaav ighe i kinik to yes Yuda.’”
Eemon Piladus iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Mako. Saveeŋ tau naboode na, ene aat igheen tauvene.”

Zaaba tana tirav Yesu izala ai pambarooŋ le isov, ra tigham nonoghiiŋa tooni tomania gabua tooni siriv paam ve tivalagh zi imin paaŋ, ve tirei irau zi. Eemon nonoghiiŋa tooni to ŋgoaaŋ, ene saiŋ mako.

Tauvene zaaba tana tivasavo zi tighe: “Nonoghiiŋa to ŋgoaaŋ tane, taraŋgati sov. Igheen tauvene, ve tapayooz mbuur ve taghita: Sei pale ighamu?” Tauvene Maaron aliiŋa ziiri ee tau tiboode na, ighur anooŋa. Isaav tauvene:

content.text: “Yes tirei nonoghiiŋa tsiau tomania gabua siriv irau zi.
Ve nonoghiiŋa tsiau to ŋgoaaŋ, ene tipayooz mbuur pani. Leso tighita sei ta pale ighamu.”

content: Ŋgar tau zaaba tighamu na, ene iduduuŋ pa saveeŋ tane.

Yesu tiina Maria yesuru tazliva, ve Maria ite tau Klopas azaawa na, ve Maria ite to nugh Magdala, ve mbiwa tau Yesu loolo igheen tooni kat na, yes tiyozyooz igharau ai pambarooŋ tooni puughu. Yesu maata izi le ighita tiina yesuru mbiwa tooni tawe tiyozyooz. Tauvene isaav pa tiina ighe: “Tinaŋ, ughita. Ena yo natum.”
Ve isaav pa mbiwa tooni ighe: “Ughita. Ena yo tinam.” Tauta saawe tana ve ila, mbiwa tana igham Yesu tiina ila ruum tooni, ve iŋgini.
Yesu imaat

Yesu isavsaav pa tiina ve mbiwa tooni tana le isov, ra iwatagh ighe i ipasovuur uraat tooni naol isov wa. Tauvene isaav ighe: “Yau murun ghau!” Saveeŋ tane, i isavia leso Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na ighur anooŋa.
Uur ee tomania vaen maŋiŋi igheen igharau. Tauvene tigham gabua tau ighogholoom yaa na, ve tizeeva izila vaen tawe. Ra tighurumu ila ai isop booga ve tizuzuuna izala pa Yesu aavo.
Yesu igholoom vaen tana le isov, ve isaav ighe: “Uraat tsiau, ene isov tane.” Ra iŋgoor luua, ipul avuvu ila, ve imaat.
Tighurum Yesu raŋraaŋo saamba

Saawe tana, ene saawe to titartar pa umbom patabuyaaŋ tau ighe ivot. Umbom tana, ene patabuyaaŋ kat. Tauvene daaba to yes Yuda tila to Piladus, ve tighasoni tighe i isaav ila pa yes zaaba gha tirav polin yes tau tituktuuk ila ai pambarooŋ na aghezi. Leso timaat rekia, ve tizugh zi tizi, gha tila titavi zi. Le isov, o umbom patabuyaaŋ ivot.
Tauvene zaaba tila, ve tirav polin zeran ru tau tirav zi tomania Yesu na aghezi.
Tirav polin yesuru aghezi le isov, ra tila pa Yesu aana. Eemon tighita i imaat wa. Tauta tirav polin aaghe mako.
Eemon zaaba ee igham iiz, ve ighurum Yesu raŋraaŋo saamba. Ve rekia mon siŋ tomania yaa imaliŋ.
Ŋeer tau ighita gabua tawe pa tauu maata, tauta isavia. Ve i iwatagh: Saveeŋ tooni, ene onoon. Pasaa, i ighit katin gabua tana. Tauta ipariaaŋ saveeŋa, leso yam paam aghur ila.
Gabua tane tivot pa Yesu, leso Maaron aliiŋa ziiri ee tau tiboode na ighur anooŋa. Saveeŋ tauvene:
Ve saveeŋ ziiri ite isaav tauvene:

content.text: “Pale matazi ila pa ŋeer tau tighurumu na.”

content: Tighur Yesu paata ila naal loolo

Gabua tana tivotiir le isov, ra Yosep to nugh Arimatea ila ighason Piladus ighe iyokia Yesu paata pani, leso ighamu ila ve ighuru iloŋ ila naal. Yosep tawe, i mbiwa ee to Yesu. Eemon ivotia ghuruuŋ ila tooni ivot ighazooŋ mako. Pasaa, iroi pa yes Yuda. Piladus iyok pani, tauvene i ila pa ghamuuŋ Yesu paata.

Ve Nikodemus tau muuŋ ila to Yesu ve yesuru tisavsaav pa mboŋ na, i paam ila tomania Yosep. I igham ŋgoreeŋ tiina tau vaazi poia na, ve ilam. Ŋgoreeŋ tawe, pataŋani tooni tiina, irau 30 kilogram ma vene.
Yesuru tila tigham Yesu paata, ve tila tigharaata itaghon yes Yuda gabuazi tau monmon tighamgham pa mateegha toozi. Tisop ŋgoreeŋ tana sirivu izala Yesu paata, ve sirivu ila uuli ve tikaukauu.
Nugh tau tirav Yesu pani na, nugh paghuuna ee igheen igharau. Ve maet puura paaghu ee tau tigharaata pataghaaŋ imin naal pa mateegha na, igheen ta sewe. Puura tawe, tighur mateegh eta iloŋ ila soone.
Saawe tana, ene saawe to yes Yuda titartar pa umbom patabuyaaŋ. Ve ravrav izi gha paita umbom patabuyaaŋ ivot. Maet puura tana igheen igharau. Tauvene tigham Yesu paata, ve tighuru iloŋ ila.

footnotes.text: Ravraav tau yes Roma tiloslos tamtamon pani na, timbit gabua matazi ila. Leso iraŋgat tamtamon ulizi ve mizazi.
-3 Yes kinik tinonogh zi pa nonoghiiŋa tau ŋgeretazi imin dagilgil.
Maaron aliiŋa ziiri naol isaav tauvene: Maaron, i kinik to yes Israela. Eemon saveeŋ ziiri tane, ene yes Yuda tizor Maaron tau kinik toozi duduuŋ na, ve tighe kinik to Rom ta iŋgin zi.
Saveeŋ ‘daaba rubruuba’, yes Roma tiwaato ila tauzi aliŋazi Latin tighe ‘Kalvari’.

Saveeŋ tau tiboode na, ene vene: Yeshua Nasaret, Hamelech Yehudah (saveeŋ Hibru), Yesus Ho Nazaraios, Ho Basileus Toon Yudaion (Grika aliŋazi), Iesus Nazarenus Reks Iudaeorum (saveeŋ Latin). Saveeŋ Latin tane, tuuku tooni ene INRI. Yesu anunu tau tigheen ila rumei siriv lolozi na, tibood saveeŋ INRI ila.
Ŋgoreeŋ tau Nikodemus ighamu na, tigharaata pa gabua ru, ezazi miir, ve aloos. Muuŋ, saawe tau Maria ipoop Yesu, yes ŋgara to aaz puughu tigham miir pa Yesu. Ughita Mt 2:11.
